doctrine: capital preservation precedes recovery; recovery proceeds only through measured, evidence-backed edge; never through size or leverage escalation
absolute_rules: no live recovery trading until paper edge is statistically positive after costs
no scaling of size until canary pass
no daily loss beyond configured cap
no weekly loss beyond configured cap
no symbol outside approved Symbol Universe scope
no trade if expected edge after cost is below operator-set threshold
no trade if model confidence calibration is missing
no trade if feature freshness is stale
no trade if risk gateway blocks
no trade if live_gate is not approved

operator_decision_notes.max_daily_loss_pct: must be expressed as % of equity-at-day-open; default applies until operator sets a numeric value; absent value blocks any live or canary action
operator_decision_notes.max_weekly_loss_pct: must be expressed as % of equity-at-week-open; absent value blocks scaling
operator_decision_notes.max_position_notional_pct: % of equity per position; intentionally conservative
operator_decision_notes.max_consecutive_losses: trigger kill-switch after N consecutive losses within the configured window
operator_decision_notes.canary_order_size: minimal size used during canary validation; intentionally small to bound downside while collecting evidence
operator_decision_notes.min_expected_edge_after_cost_bps: trades below this threshold are blocked by the risk gateway
operator_decision_notes.min_confidence_calibrated: trades below this calibrated confidence are blocked
operator_decision_notes.max_feature_freshness_seconds: if any selected feature is older than this, the trade is blocked
operator_decision_notes.max_concurrent_positions: concurrent-position cap to bound correlated risk
operator_decision_notes.kill_switch_consecutive_losses_window_ho: rolling window over which consecutive losses are counted

approval_path: 1. operator sets all numeric caps above
2. paper/shadow edge is certified by Codex review (positive after-cost expectancy, minimum trade count)
3. V2-vs-legacy decision-match rate certified above operator threshold
4. live_canary safety markers prepared by operator
5. canary order activated with minimal size
6. scaling allowed only after each scaling step passes a separate operator review
do_not_perform_autonomously: set numeric caps without operator input
place, cancel, or modify exchange orders
